body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/bugs.md (entry dated 2026-09-19).

At `93a103141589a97dbdc05c7864845299ae311cc5`, the checkout example in `cmd/corvint/docs.go` and `docs/specs/source-documentation-draft-v0.md` fails: `corvint docs draft --source docs/specs/source-documentation-draft-v0.md --package internal/doccompiler` returns `documentation-limit-exceeded` (`more than 64 declarations or importers`) and no Markdown. `TestDocsHelpPrerequisitesAndWorkingExample` passes because its synthetic package exports only `Plan`; it does not exercise the real checkout example. The same source with `--package internal/docmaintain` successfully drafts and consumes. Fix the advertised example and verify its real committed-source round trip without weakening the bound.

completion.reason: BUILD-LOG batch-A cmd/corvint chores, commit bf7a956; docs.go example now uses internal/docmaintain --task Preview.
